alternate_candidate_search_evidence.full_source_line_en: Every source-named interface retains validation before long-running allocation. alternate_candidate_search_evidence.full_source_line_en: **Case creation/read/update:** API-003 creates idempotently (`201`), starting `NEW`; classification is asynchronous. API-004 reads authorized current revision (`200`). API-005 PATCH uses `If-Match` (`200/409`). Actor/request-fingerprint outcomes are retained for24 hours; identical same-key creation yields one case/identical response, changed-body reuse yields `409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT`. Conflict returns `CASE_VERSION_CONFLICT` and current revision without changing business state. Long-running-job POST mutations transport `Idempotency-Key`; its complete scope/fingerprint/expiry contract remains open. Parallel rebuilds atomically switch read alias only after completeness/recall checks; database remains authoritative. Cache keys include tenant, user-scope digest, source ACL revision, query hash and index generation. Permission change purges affected cache before TTL and next-query access remains mandatory. alternate_candidate_search_evidence.full_source_line_en: Admit new AI runs only when workspace tokens **AND** queue age **AND** provider capacity satisfy thresholds. Throttling uses `429` plus `Retry-After`, preserving saved cases. Generation outage disables new generation admission but preserves manual case editing/evidence search and shows degraded status. alternate_candidate_search_evidence.full_source_line_en: **Relationships.** Workspace groups users, policies, connectors and cases. Attachments and runs are separate entities joined by immutable identifiers; case attachments reference immutable document versions, and approvals reference run artifact hashes. Exact multiplicities and most FK declarations remain **Needs confirmation**. [pp.24,51; `data:r2:c35:f1`, `data:r2:c36:f6`, `data:r2:c84:f5`]
alternate_candidate_search_evidence.quote_en: Attachments and runs are separate entities joined by immutable identifiers

alternate_candidate_search_evidence.full_source_line_en: The platform ingests enterprise documents and user-submitted cases, searches permitted knowledge, drafts grounded responses, applies deterministic risk policy, routes uncertain/sensitive recommendations to authorized reviewers, publishes through a satisfied gate, and preserves auditable evidence. Classification, retrieval, generation, policy evaluation, approval and publication are distinct activities; separate records do not require separate screens. [Source: pp.7,11–12, §§2.1–2.2; `screen_functions:r1:c4:f1`, `screen_functions:r1:c11:f1`, `screen_functions:r1:c13:f4`]
alternate_candidate_search_evidence.quote_en: separate records do not require separate screens.

alternate_candidate_search_evidence.full_source_line_en: **Upload processing:** Scan before parsing; disable macros; do not fetch embedded remote references. Unsafe attachments quarantine without entering search. A `202` attachment response creates ingestion work, not proof of READY. Document catalog states are `ACCEPTED`, `SCANNING`, `EXTRACTING`, `INDEXING`, `READY`, `QUARANTINED`, guarded by scan and quality. Upload/status screen location, transitions, remediation and error displays are open. [Source: pp.30–31,82–83,89 TST-015; `screen_functions:r1:c48:f4`, `screen_functions:r1:c137:f4`, `screen_functions:r1:c137:f9`, `screen_functions:r1:c141:f15`]
alternate_candidate_search_evidence.quote_en: Unsafe attachments quarantine without entering search.

alternate_candidate_search_evidence.full_source_line_en: Normalization cannot rewrite source claims. Content fingerprint/pipeline version identifies immutable derivatives; changed normalization can coexist side by side. No comparison/reprocess control is specified. [Source: p.31 §8.2.2; `screen_functions:r1:c49:f5`]

alternate_candidate_search_evidence.full_source_line_en: Cross-service writes must be retry-safe. At-least-once consumers check ledger/event identity and aggregate revision, record duplicate outcome and do not reapply mutation; delayed events are safe without cross-partition order reliance. Rejected stale/unauthorized writes leave business state unchanged before the relevant event publication. alternate_candidate_search_evidence.full_source_line_en: 2. Retrieve only current permitted evidence before releasing text to generation. Form lexical/normalized vector queries, bounded candidates, reciprocal rank fusion, deterministic rerank, document/source diversity and per-query token budget. Ranking never authorizes. Evidence includes chunk ID/source title/document revision/page anchor/ACL digest; citation identifiers are opaque/verified.
alternate_candidate_search_evidence.quote_en: Ranking never authorizes.

alternate_candidate_search_evidence.full_source_line_en: 4. Apply current ACL before retrieval text reaches generation and again at publication after permission changes. Ranking, immutable versions, cached results and prior approval never grant continuing access.
alternate_candidate_search_evidence.quote_en: Ranking, immutable versions, cached results and prior approval never grant continuing access.

alternate_candidate_search_evidence.full_source_line_en: Retrieval uses scoped tenant/workspace/version/chunk/language/classification rows, normalized text and **1536-dimensional embeddings**. Form lexical and normalized vector queries; bounded candidate retrieval → reciprocal rank fusion → deterministic reranking → redundancy/source-diversity control, subject to model-token cap and ACL filtering. No RRF equation, constant, scoring tie rule or selected numeric candidate/token limit is supplied by this operative prose. alternate_candidate_search_evidence.full_source_line_en: Every request binds an authenticated principal and tenant. Authorization combines role, tenant, workspace membership, case sensitivity, source ACL, action and separation of duties. Apply checks at edge, domain transaction, retrieval, tool dispatch and publication as applicable; hiding or disabling navigation is not authorization. Originating ACL filtering precedes text release to generation. Cross-tenant resource substitution returns the absent-resource not-found response class without disclosing private existence. [Source: pp.21–23 §§5.1–5.3,34 chapter9,89 TST-003; `screen_functions:r1:c29:f1`, `screen_functions:r1:c31:f4`, `screen_functions:r1:c32:f4`, `screen_functions:r1:c53:f2`, `screen_functions:r1:c141:f3`]

Form lexical/normalized vector queries, bound candidates, RRF merge, deterministic rerank, diversify documents/sources and cap model-context tokens. Internal search rows retain tenant/workspace/version/chunk/language/classification, normalized text and **1536-dimensional embeddings**. Parallel rebuilds atomically switch read alias only after completeness/recall checks; database remains authoritative. Cache keys include tenant, user-scope digest, source ACL revision, query hash and index generation. Permission change purges affected cache before TTL and next-query access remains mandatory. Insufficient quality/confidence returns `NO_SUPPORTED_EVIDENCE`, never fabricated context; clarification versus human route is unresolved. alternate_candidate_search_evidence.full_source_line_en: **Publication is distinct from approval.** Required evidence and satisfied versioned deterministic policy are prerequisites; unapproved high-risk runs cannot publish. Approval binds exactly reviewed content. Final-response pointer and satisfied gate commit atomically; replay cannot publish another artifact under old approval. Recompute authorization at publication after intervening tenant/document permission changes; reject stale evidence even after successful search/review. Publication invoker, endpoint/button, exact status mapping and recovery are open. alternate_candidate_search_evidence.full_source_line_en: The platform ingests enterprise documents and user-submitted cases, searches permitted knowledge, drafts grounded responses, applies deterministic risk policy, routes uncertain/sensitive recommendations to authorized reviewers, publishes through a satisfied gate, and preserves auditable evidence. Classification, retrieval, generation, policy evaluation, approval and publication are distinct activities; separate records do not require separate screens. [Source: pp.7,11–12, §§2.1–2.2; `screen_functions:r1:c4:f1`, `screen_functions:r1:c11:f1`, `screen_functions:r1:c13:f4`]
alternate_candidate_search_evidence.quote_en: Classification, retrieval, generation, policy evaluation, approval and publication are distinct activities

alternate_candidate_search_evidence.full_source_line_en: Admit new AI runs only when workspace tokens **AND** queue age **AND** provider capacity satisfy thresholds. Throttling uses `429` plus `Retry-After`, preserving saved cases. Generation outage disables new generation admission but preserves manual case editing/evidence search and shows degraded status. Optional lexical fallback during vector degradation requires a visible reduced-quality flag. Never bypass authorization/approval. Pages require user-impact incidents; routine spend creates owner/threshold tickets; provider-outage page only when availability budget impacted. [PDF pp.65,68–69,79; `business_rules:r1:c109:f7`, `business_rules:r1:c113:f2`, `business_rules:r1:c115:f1`, `business_rules:r1:c115:f4`, `business_rules:r1:c115:f5`, `business_rules:r1:c133:f1`]
alternate_candidate_search_evidence.quote_en: Generation outage disables new generation admission but preserves manual case editing/evidence search and shows degraded status.

alternate_candidate_search_evidence.full_source_line_en: **Retrieval:** ACL filtering precedes generation text release; relevance never grants access. Form lexical/normalized vector queries, bound candidates, RRF merge, deterministic rerank, diversify documents/sources and cap model-context tokens. Internal search rows retain tenant/workspace/version/chunk/language/classification, normalized text and **1536-dimensional embeddings**. Parallel rebuilds atomically switch read alias only after completeness/recall checks; database remains authoritative. Cache keys include tenant, user-scope digest, source ACL revision, query hash and index generation. Permission change purges affected cache before TTL and next-query access remains mandatory. Insufficient quality/confidence returns `NO_SUPPORTED_EVIDENCE`, never fabricated context; clarification versus human route is unresolved. [Source: pp.34–36,53; `api:r1:c53:f2`, `api:r1:c54:f1`, `api:r1:c54:f5`, `api:r1:c55:f1`, `api:r1:c55:f4`, `api:r1:c56:f5`, `api:r1:c86:f7`]
alternate_candidate_search_evidence.quote_en: Retrieval: ACL filtering precedes generation text release

alternate_candidate_search_evidence.full_source_line_en: Cross-service writes must be retry-safe. At-least-once consumers check ledger/event identity and aggregate revision, record duplicate outcome and do not reapply mutation; delayed events are safe without cross-partition order reliance. Rejected stale/unauthorized writes leave business state unchanged before the relevant event publication. Accepted transitions require one audit record and tenant-scoped traces; diagnostic telemetry excludes source text. [Source: pp.15,48–50,59; `screen_functions:r1:c17:f2`, `screen_functions:r1:c78:f4`, `screen_functions:r1:c79:f8`, `screen_functions:r1:c82:f1`, `screen_functions:r1:c82:f3`, `screen_functions:r1:c100:f1`]

Canonical event fields are separately `event_id`, `type`, `schema_version`, `tenant_id`, `aggregate_id`, `aggregate_revision`, `occurred_at`, `trace_id`, `payload`, using UTC/canonical JSON; aliases between the lists are not supplied. Evidence-set storage supports later publish validation, not authority. [pp.35,85; `processing_flows:r1:c56:f1`, `processing_flows:r1:c138:f11`]

alternate_candidate_search_evidence.full_source_line_en: Deterministic tests avoid live model calls and pin provider adapters. Disposable integration covers transactions, replay, ACL revocation, delayed indexing and purge. Synthetic fixtures cover successful/empty/mixed-permission/adversarial/malformed; each randomized seed recorded; corpora frozen/versioned/independently leakage-reviewed. Complete minimum pipeline: unit, schema evolution, negative authorization, workflow replay, staging connector sync, visual accessibility, search recall, grounding, policy recall, load and DR. Sign outputs and reference release digest. Empty fixture coverage does not define runtime successful no-op behavior. [PDF pp.74–75,89; `business_rules:r1:c126:f1`, `business_rules:r1:c126:f6`, `business_rules:r1:c126:f7`, `business_rules:r1:c141:f17`, `business_rules:r1:c141:f18`, `business_rules:r1:c141:f19`, `business_rules:r1:c141:f20`, `business_rules:r1:c141:f21`, `business_rules:r1:c141:f22`]

Release records bind image/schema/prompt/model-routing policy, and versions must be reconstructible. Gate thresholds/signatures/interfaces remain open. alternate_candidate_search_evidence.full_source_line_en: Retrieval uses scoped tenant/workspace/version/chunk/language/classification rows, normalized text and **1536-dimensional embeddings**. Form lexical and normalized vector queries; bounded candidate retrieval → reciprocal rank fusion → deterministic reranking → redundancy/source-diversity control, subject to model-token cap and ACL filtering. No RRF equation, constant, scoring tie rule or selected numeric candidate/token limit is supplied by this operative prose. Cache identity includes tenant, user-scope digest, ACL revision, query hash and index generation; authorization change purges before normal TTL and must satisfy the stronger next-retrieval rule. alternate_candidate_search_evidence.full_source_line_en: **Search:** Apply lexical and normalized vector retrieval, bounded candidates, reciprocal rank fusion, deterministic reranking, source diversity and per-query model-token budgets. Ranking is not authorization. Revoked source access must be effective **before next retrieval**, even while index cleanup is pending; source ACL changes invalidate affected cache before new results. Query fields, search placement, blank-query behavior, filtering and sorting remain open. If confidence/quality is insufficient, return `NO_SUPPORTED_EVIDENCE`, not fabricated context; clarification versus human routing needs a decision. Missing-citation generation has needs-review **or** unsupported outcome under TST-009, not a selected universal state. [Source: pp.27–29,34–36,89; `screen_functions:r1:c41:f2`, `screen_functions:r1:c43:f4`, `screen_functions:r1:c55:f1`, `screen_functions:r1:c55:f4`, `screen_functions:r1:c56:f4`, `screen_functions:r1:c141:f4`, `screen_functions:r1:c141:f9`]

alternate_candidate_search_evidence.full_source_line_en: Admit new AI runs only when workspace tokens **AND** queue age **AND** provider capacity satisfy thresholds. alternate_candidate_search_evidence.full_source_line_en: **Retrieval:** ACL filtering precedes generation text release; relevance never grants access. Form lexical/normalized vector queries, bound candidates, RRF merge, deterministic rerank, diversify documents/sources and cap model-context tokens. Internal search rows retain tenant/workspace/version/chunk/language/classification, normalized text and **1536-dimensional embeddings**. Parallel rebuilds atomically switch read alias only after completeness/recall checks; database remains authoritative. Cache keys include tenant, user-scope digest, source ACL revision, query hash and index generation. Permission change purges affected cache before TTL and next-query access remains mandatory. Insufficient quality/confidence returns `NO_SUPPORTED_EVIDENCE`, never fabricated context; clarification versus human route is unresolved. [Source: pp.34–36,53; `api:r1:c53:f2`, `api:r1:c54:f1`, `api:r1:c54:f5`, `api:r1:c55:f1`, `api:r1:c55:f4`, `api:r1:c56:f5`, `api:r1:c86:f7`]
alternate_candidate_search_evidence.quote_en: Internal search rows retain tenant/workspace/version/chunk/language/classification, normalized text and 1536-dimensional embeddings.

alternate_candidate_search_evidence.full_source_line_en: Retrieval uses scoped tenant/workspace/version/chunk/language/classification rows, normalized text and **1536-dimensional embeddings**. Form lexical and normalized vector queries; bounded candidate retrieval → reciprocal rank fusion → deterministic reranking → redundancy/source-diversity control, subject to model-token cap and ACL filtering. No RRF equation, constant, scoring tie rule or selected numeric candidate/token limit is supplied by this operative prose. Cache identity includes tenant, user-scope digest, ACL revision, query hash and index generation; authorization change purges before normal TTL and must satisfy the stronger next-retrieval rule. [PDF pp.34–36,53; `business_rules:r1:c54:f1`, `business_rules:r1:c55:f1`, `business_rules:r1:c55:f6`, `business_rules:r1:c86:f7`, `business_rules:r1:c86:f8`]
